snippet.title: Petit Planet - Planet Design Trailer | Coziness Test Now Live!
snippet.description:
Plant a planet to call your own, and nurture it into the planet of your dreams.
Shining among the countless stars is a life we've always longed for.

Petit Planet Coziness Test is now live as of 9:00 (UTC+8), November 7! Check the official site to see if you've got access!

📄 Test sign-ups and pre-registration are still open →https://hoyo.link/t9ATptBWn
